endorsements.name: Dhiraj Mishra
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37079
endorsements.description: Wing FTP Server versions prior to 6.2.7 contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the web administration interface that allows attackers to delete admin users. Attackers can craft a malicious HTML page with a hidden form to submit a request that deletes the administrative user account without proper authorization.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.1)

endorsements.name: Dhiraj Mishra
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-6789
endorsements.description: Loading a DLL through an Uncontrolled Search Path Element in the Bosch Monitor Wall installer up to and including version 10.00.0164 potentially allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on a victim's system. A prerequisite is that the victim is tricked into placing a malicious DLL in the same directory where the installer is started from.
